request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise-object-edit. ONE static source image for a Don't Starve Together building's ground-range effect. 1024 x 1024, true transparent RGBA. Top-down circular layout; the furnace and ground-plane perspective will be composited separately.

Reference image: our old effect, supplied for its DIFFERENT arc silhouettes, irregular pointed ink outlines and cyan/gold paint treatment. Preserve that shape vocabulary: split trailing tails, curved hooks, sharp notches, angular bends. The old pieces are far too large and encroach too far into the interior; redesign them much smaller and move the whole composition to the circular OUTER PERIMETER. Remove the diamond crystals and hollow purple runes.

PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: an organic, lively broken ring of MANY DIFFERENT small magical arc fragments. They are scattered with intentional irregular rhythm on the outer circumference, some a little inward, some outward. Their silhouettes must be visibly DIFFERENT, not one identical leaf rotated and evenly repeated. Combine long slim swept blades, stubby strongly curved hooks, split double-tailed little wisps, crooked sharply bent arcs with a notch, and short curved scraps. Use contrasting shapes next to each other. Long to short lengths vary by about 3 to 1. Keep the reference's lively irregularity and hand-inked silhouette character while reducing each piece to a small accent.

LAYOUT AND SCALE: center (512,512), outer limit radius 478. Everything stays in the outer annulus from radius 395 to 478 (approximately the outer 17 percent of the radius); the entire large hole inside radius 395 is perfectly empty transparent. Draw approximately 20 small main arcs and 4 to 6 shorter companion arc fragments. Main arcs are 55 to 110 pixels long, only 15 to 32 pixels wide at a curved shoulder, tapering sharply. Short companions are 22 to 45 pixels long. No single piece longer than 115 pixels. Thus every piece will be much smaller than the furnace which is composited later. Do not enlarge individual arcs to fill empty sectors.

STAGGERED DISTRIBUTION: most arcs sit closer to the outer edge, but some hooks and forked arcs sit 25 to 50 pixels farther inward. Create 3 or 4 small local groups of two or three unlike fragments that pass alongside each other at different radial positions, with visible gaps. Between these groups put isolated arcs and larger breathing gaps. Balance interest around the full circle but NEVER use equal angular spacing, exact rotational symmetry, a uniform dotted line, evenly repeated identical leaves, a clean continuous ring, or two concentric rows. The circular shape is implied by the whole ensemble, not traced by an exact geometric line. Arcs generally sweep tangentially in a shared flowing direction, with gentle local tilt variation. Nothing spirals across the center.

COLOR AND STYLE: two-thirds muted icy cyan and one-third antique gold, plus at most two tiny dark mauve arc scraps like the reference's shadow-colored wisps. No fixed repeating color sequence. Don't Starve Together two-dimensional hand-painted world-asset style: lively charcoal tapered outlines, purposeful little forked tips and sharp indentations, quiet colored planes and one small pale highlight, sparse directional brush marks. Each piece is readable with modest thickness; not hairline dashes. No halo, broad glow, smoky aura or painted disk. No white neon, glitter, photographic texture, uniform noise or smooth vector clip art. No material inside the empty center. No scene, building, bottles, characters, floor, shadows, text, labels, frame or extra ornaments. Output the entire source with generous transparent outer margin and no cropped strokes.
